messages:
kevin: FYI — Acme (Dedicated) asked for a per-tenant canary flow that keeps traffic isolated to their GPU pool and allows a configurable traffic split. They also want automatic rollback if error-rate > 2% for 5m. Can we sketch an API + console UX?
anh: +1. We need two pieces: a routing policy that pins tenant->pool and a canary traffic rule (percentage + guards). Suggest extending /routes API.
maya: A few constraints: 1) tenant isolation must prevent fallback to shared hosts, 2) quota accounting should still work per-tenant, 3) telemetry needs a canary flag so dashboards show the cohort separately.
anh: Proposal (API payload idea):
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "acme",
  "canary": {
    "traffic_percent": 10,
    "target_pool": "dedicated-acme-v2",
    "guards": {
      "error_rate_pct": 2,
      "window_secs": 300
    },
    "fallback": "none"  
  }
}
```
kevin: I like that. Note the fallback:none is required for strict isolation — we can't route to shared. But we should surface a clear warning in console if capacity is insufficient.
oliver: For the console UX: dropdown for target_pool (only pools with matching affinity), slider for traffic percent, toggle for "strict isolation" which enforces fallback:none. Show live estimated QPS and capacity headroom.
maya: Telemetry: mark requests with header `X-Canary-Cohort: acme-2026-03-??` and tag traces. Add a per-tenant canary timeseries in Console -> Rollouts. Also emit a canary_event when guard trips.
deploy-bot: canary-created: tenant=acme, id=canary-1768504321, traffic=10%, pool=dedicated-acme-v2
anh: Implementation concerns: 1) routing-engine must evaluate tenant-level policy before global routing to honor isolation. 2) quota checks must apply to canary traffic against tenant reserved capacity if present. 3) autoscale: canary shouldn’t trigger global autoscale; tie to pool-level metrics.
kevin: Ops guardrails: require a capacity check gate in API that returns 409 with capacity details if not enough headroom and "force=true" to override (but console should block override for strict isolation).
maya: Tests: e2e with traffic split simulator, fault injection to raise error-rate, ensure automatic rollback and canary_event emitted.
kevin: OK next steps: Anh -> PR for /routes change; Oliver -> console mockups; Maya -> telemetry spec + event names. I'll coordinate with Acme SRE for a pilot next week. :thumbsup:
anh: on it, will draft PR and include unit tests for routing precedence.
oliver: mockups WIP, will post screenshots in #design later today.
